problems: The gloss black stove top acts as a mirror: it reflects the yellow tiled wall and the pot so strongly that it reads as more yellow tiles, not a black gas stove top. Make it a dark satin finish.

The fire, a hero color, is almost invisible. The pot sits only about 0.06 above the burner cap, so the small flames are hidden under its base and behind the grate ring. Raise the grate arms and the pot to open a gap over the burner, and make the flames larger so their yellow-white cores and orange tips show clearly.

The fire under the pot barely shows: the flames are small, sit in a narrow gap between burner and pot base, and read as a few white blobs with almost no orange tips, while the card names a bright fire with orange curling tips.
The flame core color #fff4b8 glows pure white instead of yellow-white.
